[i][b]Grand Resort Crescent Hotel Project[/b]

The Grand Resort Crescent Hotel will be built in Jakitl Mecu, the country's capital, which is famous for tourism and culture. Recently, there have been plans to build the Grand Resort Crescent Hotel close to the beach because tourism in the area is rising gradually.

To promote tourism, the scheme involves constructing one 500m tower and two 300m towers. In addition, a shopping mall spanning 1.3 million square meters will be constructed at the base of the complex. The project will also feature a parking lot with 8,000 parking slots above ground and a 2,000 slot garage underground. The structure will be done in about 4 to 5 years, and the estimated completion date is May 30, 2030. The project will be financed through a $3 billion loan provided by the [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]. With an estimated cost of $4.433 billion.

[/i]

[quote=united_hydronia;59311265]Sir I see something! I think its the Sal-Baliz! Shouts a young private over the din. Suddenly everything goes quiet.
Can we have confirmation on that General Eden says down a radio. A few seconds, then a response.
Confirmed, a unit of around 1,000
That isnt many? He thought to himself, before calling for everyone to get ready. An army of soldiers from the BR. Bob, Indonocaismnic and Hydronia all assemble into formation. The first gunshots echoed through the desert and into the holy city. The sound of panic resonates out of the city walls.
Fire! Eren calls and in an instant the first 10 soldiers have been mowed down by machine gun fire. The machine guns continued to fire, but the coalition forces also suffered. Soon soldiers on both sides were dropping like flies. 

As the battle continued to escalate, Eren gave the order to use missiles and tanks. Small rockets zoomed through the air towards the hill, scattering sand everywhere. Tanks rolled forward, but were ineffective to the enemy grenades. Despite this, the Sal-Baliz were greatly outnumbered and the battle was making progress. That is until a few hours in. The Sal-Baliz had suffered heavy casualties and were forced to hold their position behind the hill. The coalition was slowly gaining ground, but suddenly a sound was heard in the distance, from behind the city. A Bobian soldier spotted something in the distance,
A ship! He cried out, A ship!
Hoards of pirates armed with everything from knives to rocket launchers had landed and were making their way towards the city. It appeared the Sal-Baliz had hired criminals in order to assist the war effort. Confusion followed as the army was split in two to fight the enemy from both sides. Amidst this confusion yet another unexpected twist took place. Rumbling came from above and with it a team of 100 paratroopers. The [nation]extreme Islam rebels of asyla[/nation] that had fled to Sal-Baliz have been put to work. The army descended into chaos as attacks came from all fronts

[nation]British Republic of Bob[/nation] and [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation], I would appreciate it if you guys continued this battle, because I am kinda busy at the moment and have created this post just to kick-start the battle a bit. Also sorry if it seems kinda rushed and is not to my usual standard of writing.[/quote]

[i]Phase 1, Securing the Hill
The first division, Frontline Assault, began advancing against the hill occupied by the enemy. Caesar howitzers launched a deafening barrage that caused explosions with sand hurled into the air. Sal-Baliz defenders returned fire with intermittent shots and RPGs, but their lines were collapsing under coalition coordination.

Eren yelled into the radio: "Don't stop! We need to capture that hill before the reinforcements get here!"
K2 Black Panthers and Altay tanks led the way, swinging their guns to fire at clusters of enemies. Soldiers trailed behind them, utilizing the tanks as cover. Despite fierce resistance from some points, the coalition forces reached the base of the hill in under an hour. Machine guns blazed as the soldiers cleared out enemy fighters who were entrenched, advancing steadily but slowly.

Phase 2, The Pirates Strike Back

When the coalition looked ready to win on the hill, chaos broke out from behind. The pirates, carrying a mix of rough but dangerous weapons, attacked the coalition's supply lines like a swarm of locusts.
Division 2: Logistics and Support was taken by surprise when its supply and transport areas were assaulted. Bobian soldiers rapidly gathered to protect these crucial points, building barricades out of supply boxes and vehicles. CH-53Gs passed above, bringing in more soldiers while shooting down at the pirates.

Hold the line! Protect the supplies at all costs!" a logistics officer screamed as rockets flew past, just missing a stationary A400M Atlas.

Phase 3, Air Threats and Chaos
Overhead, the sound of engines announced the arrival of a fresh enemy force. The Extreme Islam Rebels of Asyla paratroopers dropped from the sky like vultures, landing amid the confused coalition soldiers. Their unexpected arrival contributed to the mayhem as firefights erupted in all directions.

Division 4, Air and Artillery Support, fought hard to wrest back control of the skies. T129 ATAK and Apache helicopters attacked paratroopers in bold low-flying sorties, weapons blazing. Eurocopter Tigers protected troops on the ground, their missiles flashing towards the enemy lines.

At the same time, HIMARS and MARS II rocket systems shifted their focus to the new threats, raining fire on advancing pirates and dug-in paratroopers with equal alacrity. Despite their superior numbers, the coalition's advantage in firepower soon began to swing the odds in their favor.

Phase 4, Counteroffensive of Alpha Division Amid the disorganization, Division 5: Alpha Division moved into action. With their cutting-edge reconnaissance drones, they efficiently detected vulnerabilities within the pirate and paratrooper lines. With surgical accuracy, the anthropomorphic troops conducted hit-and-run attacks, confusing the enemy advances and enabling the coalition to reorganize.

We've got them disorganized! Push them back!" yelled a commander in Alpha Division, his voice firm in the middle of the combat noise.

The Otokar Cobra IIs and the Humvees moved across the battlefield, offering mobile firepower. The cooperative actions of the light infantry units created openings for the armored divisions to make progress once again. Last Attempt. With the hours ticking by, the battlefield was a maelstrom of explosions, smoke, and shouting. General Eden called for a fierce attack, uniting all divisions in a concerted effort. The coalition forces, with their superior training and equipment, set about systematically disassembling the rest of the enemy's defenses. By night, all of Sal-Baliz's troops were in withdrawal, and his mercenaries dispersed. The alliance won but at high expense. The battlefield was strewn with crashed vehicles and the dead of both sides. Nevertheless, the holy city was intact, its sacred walls now protected by the alliance.[/i]
